title: The Sticky Note Story
subtitle: 考点：发明故事 / invent, later on, be supposed to
passage: In 1968, a scientist named Spencer Silver was trying to make a very strong glue. He failed. His glue was weak, and it was not supposed to be that way. But it did something strange: it stuck to paper, and it could be pulled off again without any damage. For years, nobody knew what to do with it.

Later on, another man, Arthur Fry, found a use for it. He sang in a church choir, and the small pieces of paper in his songbook kept falling out. He remembered Silver's glue and put it on the back of the paper. The notes stayed in place and came off easily. The company began to produce sticky notes, and today people all over the world use them at home and in the office.
